text:
maria: Quick sync — post-launch SEO sweep for the webinar landing, benchmark narrative posts, and the new integrations page. I made a URL mapping + schema + redirect sheet: https://tiny.redwood/seo-postlaunch (please don't break). Need owners for: canonical rules, JSON-LD snippets, redirect patterns, internal link updates. Can we lock by EOD Friday?

alex: I can own canonical and redirect patterns. I'll start with a list of legacy URLs that need 301s to the new canonical structure.

sophie: I’ll take schema (JSON-LD) and webinar markup — tracking event schema + speakership microdata. Will add examples to the sheet.

chris: I can handle internal nav linking and the in-page TOC updates on blog templates. Quick Q: do we prefer site-rooted canonical (e.g., https://www.redwood.inference/...) for the benchmark posts or the topic-cluster canonical?

maria: Topic-cluster canonical for pillar posts, site-rooted for product landing pages. Add exceptions column in the sheet.

alex: For redirects, suggest pattern-based rules first to cover batches, then single-URL fallbacks. Example nginx rule i'm proposing:```rewrite ^/old-blog/(.*)$ /blog/$1 permanent;```We'll also need to map querystring variants (utm) to strip in the redirect target.

sophie: For JSON-LD: I'll add a baseline Event + Article schema. Sample snippet I'll drop in the sheet:```{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "Event",
  "name": "Redwood Inference: Cost & Latency Benchmarks Webinar",
  "startDate": "2026-04-10T16:00:00Z",
  "url": "https://www.redwood.inference/webinar/cost-latency-2026"
}```Keep it minimal and valid.

chris: For internal links, plan: add contextual crosslinks from benchmark posts -> product landing -> docs. Also update sidebar nav: add webinar as a promoted resource for two weeks. I'll create a PR with the link map.

maria: Great. Owners summary in the sheet: Alex = redirects/canonical, Sophie = schema/webinar markup, Chris = internal linking + PR. I'll handle QA + analytics tagging.

alex: One edge case — we have an old /benchmarks/latency-2024 slug indexed. Recommend permanent redirect to the new canonical and keep a noindex meta on duplicate archive pages until indexing settles.

sophie: Also adding Event attendance schema with @type Person for speakers so it surfaces in rich results. Will keep speaker bios short to avoid duplication across pages.

chris: Do we need a staging CDN purge after redirects go live? deploy-bot, any constraints on schedule?

deploy-bot: @channel Planned CDN purge window available tonight 22:00-23:00 UTC. Use tag "postlaunch-seo" in the deploy form.

maria: Perfect. Timeline: redirects + canonical PRs by Thu EOD, schema + examples by Thu EOD, internal link PR by Fri AM, deploy + purge Fri 22:00 UTC. If any blockers call out here.

alex: I'll add test cases to the sheet (200/301/404 checks) and a curl example: ```curl -I https://www.redwood.inference/old-blog/post -> HTTP/1.1 301 Moved Permanently```

sophie: Adding structured-data testing checklist (rich results test links) to the sheet now.

chris: I'll put the PR links in the sheet and tag reviewers.

maria: Thanks team — will run a quick post-deploy check Monday morning for indexing signals and report in #marketing. :rocket:
